"""Verify D456 native frames from originals, close owned analysis, curate D461."""
import collections
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT=Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment_retry14_baseline')
RAW=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OLD=Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment/results/ieee_tc/p2_backend_qualification/d456_20261012')
OUT=ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/main_comparison/d461_native_frames'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts import ieee_tc_preflight as p
load=lambda path:json.loads(path.read_text())
def save(path,value):
    with path.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
identity=p.scope_identity(p.cg_path().name)
save(RAW/'curation_v3_identity.json',identity)
closures=load(RAW/'v2_failure_closure.json')
report=load(RAW/'inspection.json')
sealed=load(ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/p2_backend/d456_controller/controller_summary.json')
pins={r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in sealed['source_refs']}
for ref in report['refs']:
    assert p.digest(Path(ref['path']))==ref['sha256']
assert p.digest(OLD/'prefix1_cpu_samples.json')==pins[str(OLD/'prefix1_cpu_samples.json')]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('reader',OLD/'collect_prefix1_cpu.py')
reader=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(reader)
receipt=load(OLD/'7b_full_w0_prefix1/launch.launch/exec_receipt.json')
terminal_path=OLD/'7b_full_w0_prefix1/launch.launch/physical_deployment/request_terminals.jsonl'
terminals=[r for r,partial in reader.rows(terminal_path) if not partial]
assert len(terminals)==len({r['request_id'] for r in terminals})==1000
assert all(r['clock_id']==receipt['external_replay']['clock_id'] for r in terminals)
t0=receipt['external_replay']['replay_t0_s'];end=max(r['at'] for r in terminals)
native_file=ROOT/'faaslora/memory/gpu_monitor.py'
old_source=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','367d8507c6157d11268ca206bd614fdacde0905a:faaslora/memory/gpu_monitor.py'],cwd=ROOT)
assert old_source==native_file.read_bytes()
assert 'pinned = bool(tensor.is_pinned())' in old_source.decode().splitlines()[104]
inclusive,leaf,pin_callers=collections.Counter(),collections.Counter(),collections.Counter()
examples=[];n=missing=truncated=0
for process in report['process_details']:
    meta_path=Path(process['source_refs'][0]['path']);meta=load(meta_path)
    assert p.digest(meta_path)==pins[str(meta_path)]
    assert p.digest(meta_path.with_suffix('.stacks.jsonl'))==pins[str(meta_path.with_suffix('.stacks.jsonl'))]
    assert same_process(reader.collect_one(meta_path,t0,end),process)
    for row,partial in reader.rows(meta_path.with_suffix('.stacks.jsonl')):
        if partial:break
        if not t0<=row['observed_monotonic_s']<=end:continue
        main=[x for x in row['threads'] if x['ident']==meta['main_thread_ident']]
        if not main:missing+=1;continue
        main,=main;n+=1;truncated+=int(main['truncated'])
        chain=main['frames'];leaf[tuple(chain[0])]+=1
        inclusive.update(set((f.removeprefix(str(ROOT)+'/'),name) for f,name,line in chain if f.startswith(str(ROOT)+'/')))
        if chain[0]==[str(native_file),'add',105]:
            i=next(i for i,frame in enumerate(chain) if frame[1]=='_ieee_lora_host_inventory')
            key=tuple(chain[i+1]);pin_callers[key]+=1
            if not any(x['caller']==list(key) for x in examples):
                examples.append(dict(pid=row['pid'],index=row['index'],at=row['observed_monotonic_s'],caller=list(key),frames=chain))
assert n==report['business_samples']==1680
assert inclusive==collections.Counter({tuple(x['key']):x['count'] for x in report['inclusive_business']})
assert sum(pin_callers.values())==sum(v for (f,n,l),v in leaf.items() if f==str(native_file) and n=='add' and l==105)
assert 0<sum(pin_callers.values())<=inclusive[('faaslora/memory/gpu_monitor.py','add')]
protected=p.verify_seal(Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment/results/ieee_tc/slora_qualification/d435_20261011/protected_before.json'))
assert protected['pass'] and protected['entry_count']==147
previous=load(ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/main_comparison/d460_owner_decode/verification.json')['preserved_identities']
for path,sha in previous.items():assert p.digest(Path(path))==sha,path
assert not subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True).strip()
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
refs={r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in report['refs']}
for path in (terminal_path,native_file,RAW/'inspection.json',Path(__file__),ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/p2_backend/d456_controller/controller_summary.json'):
    refs[str(path)]=p.digest(path)
summary=dict(kind='d461_retained_native_frame_evidence_v1',passed=True,native_workers=10,
    request_window_samples=n,all_phase_samples=report['all_samples'],missing_main=missing,truncated_main=truncated,
    inclusive_business=report['inclusive_business'],nearest_business=report['nearest_business'],
    business_leaf=[dict(frame=k,samples=v) for k,v in leaf.most_common()],
    pin_query_callers=[dict(caller=k,samples=v) for k,v in pin_callers.most_common()],examples=examples,
    no_online_changes=True,no_gpu_run=True,formal_performance_result=False,cpu_time_profile=False,
    candidate_implemented=False,source_refs=[dict(path=k,sha256=v) for k,v in refs.items()],
    caveats=report['caveats']+['D456 prefix observer, not D458 full-run CPU attribution or a measured optimization.',
        'Native gpu_monitor.py is byte-identical to the D456 prelaunch commit; D457 changed controller file projections only.'])
save(OUT/'summary.json',summary)
save(OUT/'verification.json',dict(passed=True,source_count=len(refs),protected=protected,
    preserved_identities=previous,scope=identity,closures=closures,free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free,
    executed_source_sha256=p.digest(Path(__file__))))
sources=[RAW/'inspect_native.py',RAW/'curate_native.py',RAW/'curate_native_v2.py',RAW/'curation_v2_expanded_source.txt',Path(__file__),OLD/'collect_prefix1_cpu.py',OLD/'curate_callers.py']
save(OUT/'executed_sources.json',dict(sources=[dict(path=str(x),sha256=p.digest(x),content=x.read_text()) for x in sources]))
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,samples=n,missing=missing,truncated=truncated,pin_query_callers=summary['pin_query_callers'],scope=identity,verified_refs=len(refs)),indent=2))

"""Verify/backup D461 evidence without touching serving code or user changes."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
ROOT=Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment_retry14_baseline')
RAW=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'paper_results/ieee_tc/main_comparison/d461_native_frames'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts import ieee_tc_preflight as p
load=lambda x:json.loads(x.read_text())
def save(path,value):
    with path.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
identity=p.scope_identity(p.cg_path().name)
save(RAW/'backup_identity.json',identity)
expected=load(RAW/'curation_v3_identity.json')
assert p.scope_still_owned(expected)
group=Path(expected['path'])
members={str(f):f.read_text().split() for f in group.rglob('cgroup.procs')}
assert members and all(not x for x in members.values())
resources={k:(group/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.peak','memory.events','memory.swap.current')}
assert p.scope_still_owned(expected)
subprocess.run(['systemctl','--user','stop',expected['unit']],check=True)
summary=load(OUT/'summary.json')
for ref in summary['source_refs']:assert p.digest(Path(ref['path']))==ref['sha256'],ref['path']
verification=load(OUT/'verification.json')
for path,sha in verification['preserved_identities'].items():assert p.digest(Path(path))==sha,path
assert p.verify_seal(Path('/home/qhq/serverless_llm_experiment/results/ieee_tc/slora_qualification/d435_20261011/protected_before.json'))['pass']
for source in load(OUT/'executed_sources.json')['sources']:
    assert hashlib.sha256(source['content'].encode()).hexdigest()==source['sha256']==p.digest(Path(source['path']))
    ast.parse(source['content'])
extra=[RAW/'curation_v3_expanded_source.txt',Path(__file__)]
for path in extra:ast.parse(path.read_text())
assert sum(x['samples'] for x in summary['pin_query_callers'])==179
assert summary['request_window_samples']==1680 and summary['missing_main']==0
assert not subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=pid','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--','faaslora','scripts','tests'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
save(OUT/'final_verification.json',dict(passed=True,verified_refs=len(summary['source_refs']),protected=147,
    exact_line_query_samples=179,curation_closure=dict(identity=expected,resources=resources,actual_recursive_procs_empty=True),
    prior_failed_attempts_retained=True,no_serving_changes=True,no_gpu_replay=True,
    scope=identity,free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free,
    additional_executed_sources=[dict(path=str(x),sha256=p.digest(x),content=x.read_text()) for x in extra]))
paths=['docs/ieee_tc/D461_NATIVE_PIN_QUERY_EVIDENCE.md','docs/ieee_tc/EXECUTION_STATUS.md']+[str(x.relative_to(ROOT)) for x in sorted(OUT.glob('*.json'))]
assert len(paths)==6
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','add','--',*paths],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
staged=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
assert set(staged)==set(paths) and all('lora_manifest_1000.json' not in x for x in staged)
token=Path('/home/qhq/.config/primelora-tc-d75/artifact.token').read_bytes().strip()
checks={}
for name in paths:
    data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+name],cwd=ROOT)
    assert len(data)<2*1024*1024
    assert not re.search(rb'-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{25,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{25,}',data)
    assert not token or token not in data
    checks[name]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    assert checks[name]==p.digest(ROOT/name)
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--cached','--check'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
save(RAW/'staged_check.json',dict(passed=True,files=checks))
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','tc: localize retained native HOST observation cost (D461)'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','faaslora_origin','retry14_continuous_queue_v2'],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
remote=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-remote','faaslora_origin','refs/heads/retry14_continuous_queue_v2'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).split()[0]
assert head==remote
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd='/home/qhq/serverless_llm_baselines',text=True).strip()=='71c52cf6f7331dc2a171ec83db5f1011eaf6d5a6'
save(RAW/'backup_receipt.json',dict(passed=True,head=head,remote=remote,scope=identity,free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free))
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,head=head,files=len(paths),scope=identity,free_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free)))
